name: 棕亭桥 Zongting Qiao
line: 棕亭桥 at the island's north-west corner (S01, the label read as a guess): a bridge with a pavilion on it, as its name and today's rebuilding show (P0368, B for the type); every size and the roof are C.
rows: Four columns and a pyramid roof on the bridge's middle (the name, P0368: C)
Timber with red railings at Round 10's levels; stone abutments (C)
